title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page continues §39 (manuscript p.299ff), titled 'congruence conditions for the outer action of Γ_Q on π̂_{0,3}'. Setup from the previous page: there is a diagram of extensions. The top row is 1 → Ĉ^+_{1,1} ≅ SL(2,Z)^∧ → N_{1,1} → Γ_Q → 1, the arithmetic fundamental group of the moduli stack M_{1,1} over Q. It maps to the bottom row 1 → SL(2,Ẑ) → GL(2,Ẑ) → Ẑ* → 1, via the Tate-module representation and the cyclotomic character χ. Consequently the outer Galois action on SL(2,Z)^∧ descends to an outer action on the congruence completion SL(2,Ẑ). That descended action is the composite of χ: Γ_Q → Ẑ* with the map (3) Ẑ* → Out(SL(2,Ẑ)) coming from the bottom extension.

On this page Grothendieck proves that (3) factors through an injection (5) Ẑ*/Ẑ*² ↪ Out(SL(2,Ẑ)).
- Factorization: scalars λ ∈ Ẑ* ⊂ GL(2,Ẑ) act trivially by conjugation, and det(λ·I) = λ².
- Injectivity: suppose u ∈ GL(2,Ẑ) induces an inner automorphism int(u_0) with u_0 ∈ SL(2,Ẑ). Then u·u_0^{-1} centralizes SL(2,Ẑ), so it is a scalar. Hence u ∈ SL(2,Ẑ)·Ẑ* and det u ∈ Ẑ*².

On the next page this yields the conclusion. Via class field theory (Γ_Q^ab ≅ Ẑ*), the outer Galois action on SL(2,Ẑ) factors through Γ_Q^ab/2, the Galois group of the compositum of all quadratic fields, and acts faithfully there. This gives a necessary 'congruence condition' on the image of Γ_Q in Out(SL(2,Z)^∧): it must preserve the congruence kernel of SL(2,Z)^∧ → SL(2,Ẑ), and it must induce on the quotient an outer action through a homomorphism to Ẑ*/Ẑ*². The aim is to constrain Γ_Q (or a GT-like group) inside Out(π̂) using genus-1 / modular data.
errors: No real mathematical error on this page. The argument tacitly uses that the centralizer of SL(2,Ẑ) in GL(2,Ẑ) is the scalars Ẑ*. This is true (for instance, elementary matrices generate M_2(Ẑ) as a ring) but is not justified in the text.

Minor wording: what factors through Ẑ*/Ẑ*² is properly (3) (and hence (4) via χ). The page says '(4) se factorise en (5)', which is slightly loose. On the next page, 'le noyau de (5)' should read 'le noyau de (4)'.

ideas.what: The outer Galois action on SL(2,Z)^∧ = π̂_1(M_{1,1,Q̄}) descends to the congruence quotient SL(2,Ẑ), where it is given by the cyclotomic character through the extension SL2(Ẑ) → GL2(Ẑ) → Ẑ*.
ideas.modern_name: Galois action on the profinite modular group compatible with the Tate-module representation / congruence kernel
ideas.where_published: Alluded to in Esquisse d'un programme (Teichmüller tower in genus 1); not detailed there

ideas.what: The map Ẑ*/Ẑ*² → Out(SL(2,Ẑ)) induced by GL(2,Ẑ) is injective, because the centralizer of SL2 is the scalars.
ideas.modern_name: Outer automorphisms of SL2 from the determinant modulo squares

ideas.what: Via class field theory, the outer Γ_Q-action on SL(2,Ẑ) factors faithfully through Gal(Q^{multiquad}/Q) = Γ_Q^ab/2.
ideas.modern_name: Factorization through the maximal elementary abelian 2-extension of Q

deep.surprise_reason: Correct, elementary group-theoretic verification of a well-known fact: the Galois outer action on the congruence completion of SL2 reduces to quadratic characters. It is a step toward 'congruence conditions' on Γ_Q inside Out(SL(2,Z)^∧), a theme well represented in later work (Nakamura, Lochak–Schneps, Hain–Matsumoto). Nothing new to a specialist on this page.
transcription_corrections: 'u^{\ast}u_0^{-1} commute à Sl(2,Ẑ)' should read 'u·u_0^{-1} commute à Sl(2,Ẑ)' (a product, not u^*).
'Autext(Sl(2,Ẑ))' in (5): the image reads 'Autext(Sl(2,Ẑ))', consistent with the transcription.
On the next page, '(Γ_Q^{ab})_2' denotes the quotient Γ_Q^ab/(Γ_Q^ab)^2 (the 'multiquadratic' quotient), not a 2-Sylow subgroup.
